sources.title: BEIR: A Heterogeneous Benchmark for Zero-shot Evaluation of Information Retrieval Models
The Probabilistic Relevance Framework: BM25 and Beyond
sources.support_quote: BM25 is a commonly-used bag-of-words retrieval function based on token-matching between two high-dimensional sparse vectors with TF-IDF token weights

sources.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
sources.support_quote: DPR is a two-tower bi-encoder trained with a single BM25 hard negative and in-batch negatives

sources.title: ColBERT: Efficient and Effective Passage Search via Contextualized Late Interaction over BERT
sources.support_quote: ColBERT encodes and represents the query and passage into a bag of multiple contextualized token embeddings

sources.title: Approximate Nearest Neighbor Negative Contrastive Learning for Dense Text Retrieval (ANCE)
sources.support_quote: ANCE is a bi-encoder constructing hard negatives from an Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) index

sources.title: Efficiently Teaching an Effective Dense Retriever with Balanced Topic Aware Sampling (TAS-B)
sources.support_quote: TAS-B is a bi-encoder trained with Balanced Topic Aware Sampling using dual supervision from a cross-encoder and a ColBERT model

sources.title: Passage Re-ranking with BERT
sources.support_quote: Significant improvement in performance was achieved with the cross-attention mechanism of BERT

sources.title: Context-Aware Term Weighting For First Stage Passage Retrieval (DeepCT)
sources.support_quote: DeepCT used a BERT model to learn relevant term weights in a document and generated a pseudo-document representation

sources.title: From doc2query to docTTTTTquery (docT5query)
sources.support_quote: DocT5query is a popular document expansion technique using a T5 (base) model trained on MS MARCO to generate synthetic queries

sources.title: SPARTA: Efficient Open-Domain Question Answering via Sparse Transformer Matching Retrieval
sources.support_quote: SPARTA computes similarity scores between the non-contextualized query embeddings from BERT with the contextualized document embeddings

sources.title: MultiReQA: A Cross-Domain Evaluation for Retrieval Question Answering Models
sources.support_quote: MultiReQA consists of eight Question-Answering datasets and evaluates sentence-level answer retrieval given a question

sources.title: KILT: a Benchmark for Knowledge Intensive Language Tasks
sources.support_quote: KILT consists of five knowledge-intensive tasks including a total of eleven datasets... KILT retrieves documents only from Wikipedia

sources.title: MS MARCO: A Human Generated MAchine Reading COmprehension Dataset
sources.support_quote: MS MARCO Passage Ranking dataset contains 8.8M Passages and an official training set of 532,761 query-passage pairs

sources.title: MiniLM: Deep Self-Attention Distillation for Task-Agnostic Compression of Pre-Trained Transformers
sources.support_quote: a 6-layer, 384-h MiniLM cross-encoder model offers the best performance on MS MARCO

sources.title: On Biases in Information retrieval models and evaluation
sources.support_quote: selection bias: A new retrieval system might retrieve vastly different results than the system used for the annotation

sources.title: Pretrained Transformers for Text Ranking: BERT and Beyond
sources.support_quote: we refer the reader to Lin et al. for a recent survey in neural retrieval
